{"consolidated_memory":"MALFORMED RECORD IN ingest/pipeline/parser.py — Six separate occurrences with distinct root causes (2026-01-14 through 2026-05-29)

Component: ingest/pipeline/parser.py (ingest side). Recurring signal across all occurrences: a decode error pointing at one byte offset. Common repro: feed the mixed-encoding sample file.

OCCURRENCE 1: [2026-01-14, c031-e0]
Trigger: Only after the client had already retried once
Root cause: Schema drift between the migration and the model
Fix: Regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
PR: #1782, branch: fix/malformed-record-1
Result: Cold start dropped 56 percent, to 454 ms

OCCURRENCE 2: [2026-03-29, c031-e1]
Trigger: Only on the first request after a cold start
Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
PR: #3945, branch: fix/malformed-record-2
Result: p99 latency fell from 5.9 s to 934 ms

OCCURRENCE 3: [2026-04-01, c031-e2]
Trigger: Only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
Root cause: A mutable default argument shared across calls
Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
PR: #4645, branch: fix/malformed-record-3
Result: The alert stayed quiet for 69 consecutive days

OCCURRENCE 4: [2026-04-27, c031-e3]
Trigger: Only when the input list came in empty
Root cause: Clock skew between the two hosts
Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR: #4718, branch: fix/malformed-record-4
Stack: Python
Covering check: tests/ingest/test_parser.py
Result: Reclaimed 86 GB of blob storage

OCCURRENCE 5: [2026-05-12, c031-e4]
Trigger: Only for accounts in the five percent rollout bucket
Root cause: A cache entry that was never invalidated on write
Fix: Invalidated the entry inside the write transaction
PR: #7013, branch: fix/malformed-record-5
Result: The job finished in 72 minutes instead of 8 hours

OCCURRENCE 6: [2026-05-29, c031-e5]
Trigger: Only for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
Root cause: A naive datetime compared against an aware one
Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge
PR: #8986, branch: fix/malformed-record-6
Result: Memory settled at 703 MB instead of climbing past 3 GB

All occurrences worked on the same corner of ingest/pipeline/parser.py, with context carrying over from one fix to the next."}
